{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Count the number of QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_count = (df['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {qa_count}")

# Filter out QA orders
df_cleaned = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
df_loyal_completed = df_cleaned[(df_cleaned['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_cleaned['status'] == 'completed')]

# Count the number of loyal completed orders
loyal_completed_count = len(df_loyal_completed)
print(f"Number of completed orders from loyal customers: {loyal_completed_count}")

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue}")"}
